VerifiedBehavior: Native ItemStack damage may reduce the firing weapon count to zero before projectiles are spawned, but the same object retains its enchantment NBT.
Reads that current object only, matches the registered Tetanus enchantment id and clamps the snapshot to levels0-2.
No mutable global cache or last-shot state; ordinary weapons cannot borrow a preceding enchanted firing action.
Each real final-shot Multishot arrow and rocket receives its own snapshot; projectile save/load and actual advanced infection are covered by native cases.
Limits: Manual review and focused native tests are separate from the ongoing complete423-case run.
Focused controls include plain final shots, normal near-break trident throws and unbroken Multishot. No arbitrary external-mod compatibility guarantee.
